chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi from Ja'far ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah from Ja'far from his father (peace be upon them both) who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Take care of your sandals at the doors of your mosques,' and he forbade a man from putting on his shoes while standing.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on putting on shoes inside the mosque according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the Prophet's (PBUH) emphasis on maintaining the sanctity and cleanliness of mosques by keeping footwear at the entrances. The specific prohibition against putting on shoes while standing serves as a lesson in humility and deliberate reverence, preventing the haste that might detract from the spiritual atmosphere of the prayer space.
